newsitem.title: USA: Watson gets FDA OK for Microzide capsules.
newsitem.headline: Watson gets FDA OK for Microzide capsules.

text.p: Watson Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday its wholly owned subsidiary Watson Laboratories Inc had received approval from the Food and Drug Administration to market Microzide capsules for the treatment of hypertension.
The once-daily, low-dose capsule form of Microzide may be used for the treatment of mild-to-moderate hypertension, the company said.
The product is expected to be launched in the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
Watson said it saw the diuretic market for hypertension in the United States reaching $500 million in 1996.
